params.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$repo=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'HeavenBridgeSource'
if(-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $repo '.git'))){ throw "Missing HeavenBridgeSource checkout at $repo" }
git -C $repo fetch origin main --prune
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw 'fetch failed' }
git -C $repo checkout --force main
git -C $repo reset --hard origin/main
$sha=(git -C $repo rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
$version=(Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $repo 'VERSION.txt') -Raw).Trim()
Write-Output "SOURCE_SHA=$sha"
Write-Output "VERSION=$version"
dotnet build (Join-Path $repo 'src\MhwModManager.App\MhwModManager.App.csproj') -c Release -p:NuGetAudit=false
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw 'UI build failed' }
$exe=Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $repo 'src\MhwModManager.App\bin\Release') -Recurse -Filter '*.exe' | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'MHW|Mod Manager|MhwModManager' } | Select-Object -First 1
if($null -eq $exe){ throw 'App executable not found after build' }
Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.MainWindowTitle -match 'Mod Manager|Universal' } | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Start-Process -FilePath $exe.FullName -WorkingDirectory $exe.DirectoryName
Start-Sleep -Seconds 5
Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.MainWindowTitle -ne '' -and ($_.MainWindowTitle -match 'Mod Manager|Universal') } | Select-Object Id,ProcessName,MainWindowTitle | Format-Table -AutoSize
Write-Output "EXE=$($exe.FullName)"
